data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew name Jeremiah which means 'the Lord raises up', Jeramey can be translated as 'God's gift'. In the Old Testament, Jeremiah was a prophet who delivered God's messages to the Israelites. The name is associated with courage, strength, and wisdom. The name Jeramey carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jeramey usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
